name: mAIth
description: A game-driven learning system spanning mathematics, science, engineering, computing, and finance. MasterMinds connects concepts to the thinkers behind them.
ask: Improve one concept, question set, or learning pathway with provenance and validation.

name: ScrolIQ
tagline: Give ancient ink a chain of evidence.
description: Reproducible diagnostics and evidence contracts for virtual unwrapping in the Vesuvius Challenge. Scan quality, geometry, and ink claims stay distinct.
ask: Reproduce a bounded diagnostic or strengthen a falsification control.

name: Frontier Lab
description: Public experiments across models, data, routing, decoding, and inference. Simple ideas graduate through diagnostics and measurement.
ask: Propose a simple intervention with a baseline, ablation, and measurable outcome.

name: ProofBot
description: Lamport-style conversion, forward audit, and reverse audit for submitted proofs. Model-assisted reviews are distinguished from machine-checked proofs.
ask: Lock a sourced problem statement or audit a supplied proof without filling its gaps.

name: Sven’s Shelf
tagline: Books you can open, cite, and return to.
description: Deliberately released editions by Sven Hardy Benson about intelligence, institutions, markets, and changing rules. A public reader, not a mirror of drafting work.
ask: Read a released edition; propose a sourced correction through the repository’s process.

name: Bookself
description: Reusable book publishing infrastructure in the Svyable ecosystem, separate from Sven’s author identity and individual released editions.
ask: Explore the repository and propose a bounded tooling or accessibility improvement.

name: Human Kind
tagline: Turn a hopeful idea into a testable dossier.
description: An evidence-oriented commons for reducing suffering and expanding human flourishing through bounded proposals, counterevidence, and measurable next steps.
ask: Take a constrained research or skeptical-review role on an existing dossier.

name: GEMS
tagline: Search for faults. Test for leakage.
description: Geologic fault-discovery competition work with geophysical data, spatial validation, input fingerprints, and reproducible experiment records.
ask: Improve a validator or run a documented experiment; no prize or performance claim is implied.

name: ARC Prize workspace
description: Svyable’s ARC Prize 2026 repository. Consult its current README and evaluation artifacts before drawing conclusions about results.
ask: Start with the current repository brief and a reproducible evaluation question.

name: Opps
tagline: Match existing work to real opportunities.
description: A human and agent registry for prizes, bounties, paid research, and partnerships. Expected value and evidence matter more than opportunity count.
ask: Bring a credible opportunity with eligibility, deadline, cost, and source.

name: Agent Business
tagline: From a customer problem to a credible offer.
description: GitHub-native playbooks and founder packets for validation, offers, operations, machine commerce, identity, and bounded authority.
ask: Contribute a concrete business experiment or improve a machine-readable operating contract.

name: Agent for Hire
tagline: A scoped issue. A reviewable deliverable.
description: A public service-request route for AI-assisted coding work with human review. Current scope, availability, pilot prices, and terms live in the target repository.
ask: Use the target repository’s service-request form; an inquiry is not an accepted order.

name: Zarr Pyramid Audit
tagline: Inspect the structure beneath the image.
description: Svyable’s downstream fork of James Ryan’s zarr-pyramid-audit. Follow repository attribution and upstream provenance when assessing or contributing work.
ask: Improve an independent fixture or reproducible comparison while preserving upstream credit.
